execution_audit.scope: actual executed integration nodes and valid applied commands; no continuous-time guarantee
execution_audit.predicted_derivative_scope: qp and fallback describe all evaluated proposals, including rejected or unused ones; applied describes executed commands. Minima and violation counts use finite entries only; missing finite evidence is null and nonfinite proposal counts are separate. Accepted or executed residuals must be finite.
